name: @luminarylabs/nexusengine-editor
description: Static NexusEngine web editor shell for building DSK-driven games as HTML files.

scripts.cli:chess: node scripts/nexus-engine-editor-cli.mjs operations submit chess-game --param html=dist/games/nexus-chess.html --param project=dist/games/nexus-chess.project.json
scripts.cli:target-clicker: node scripts/nexus-engine-editor-cli.mjs operations submit target-clicker-game --param html=dist/games/nexus-target-clicker.html --param project=dist/games/nexus-target-clicker.project.json
scripts.cli:gem-collector: node scripts/nexus-engine-editor-cli.mjs operations submit gem-collector-game --param html=dist/games/nexus-gem-collector.html --param project=dist/games/nexus-gem-collector.project.json
scripts.test: npm run smoke:intent && npm run build && npm run smoke:playwright
